findings.description: The policy grants the svc_deploy user full wildcard access (ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, cloudwatch:*) on all resources (Resource: "*"), for example ec2:RunInstances and s3:DeleteBucket, effectively giving an unrestricted administrative identity.

A permanent IAM access key is created for an identity entitled to wildcard access; if leaked, it grants standing, non-expiring full control of EC2, S3, Lambda and CloudWatch, and rotation and revocation depend on manual process.

The deployment identity is an IAM user with static credentials rather than a role assuming short-lived credentials, and force_destroy = true permits the user to be destroyed along with its keys without a retention safeguard.
